description: A migration touching cardholder-data columns must raise a PCI/compliance flag
input:
Review this migration:
```sql
ALTER TABLE card_details ADD COLUMN pan_plaintext VARCHAR(19);
```
The card_details table stores cardholder data.
rubric: PASS only if the review raises a PCI/compliance concern about storing a plaintext PAN (cardholder data), and recommends tokenization/encryption rather than plaintext. Rating should be HIGH or CRITICAL.
